title: OpenReading Step v0.1
description: The one call every executor implements (internal/design/ledger.md §5.3/§5.4): a StepRequest in, a StepResult out. T1 ships InlineExecutor's non-replaying, non-decomposed form — one step per leaf (kind=submit only; drive/emit/translate are closed-enum members reserved for T3's full _exec_leaf decomposition, not dispatched by any T1 executor). StepResult's status enum includes 'attempted' (additive over the design doc's own list), the pre-vendor-call record InlineExecutor.exec writes before dispatch (AC-13, resolving Phase A round-1 F1).

run_id.description: Blobs are addressed per run, never globally (§5.4) — cross-run access is refused.

store.description: The BlobStore implementation id that holds this blob, e.g. 'localfs'. Null for an in-memory-only ref (ledger unarmed, L1).

step_path.description: Structural node path — never a config digest.

step_seq.description: Per-path counter (§6). T1's non-decomposed leaf always dispatches step_seq=0 — a real per-drive sequence is T3's.

content_key.description: A pure function of content + backend + resolved version + options (§5.5) — distinct from idempotency_key, which a caller may override; content_key never can.

credentials_ref.description: Key NAMES only — never resolved values.

options.description: Slim projection: outputs, pages, mime, page_count. Never document.password/url, async_.webhook_url, or a credentials_spec secret field (§9.3).

absolute_deadline_epoch_ms.description: Absolute UTC epoch milliseconds (wall clock) after which a worker must stop driving this step. Declared for the worker plane and not written by the inline executor; it crosses a process boundary, so it takes the wall clock, never Clock.now_ms.

missing_credentials.description: Ledger T3 (§4.3b): the primary env var of every required credential/config field the caller already found missing — additive, empty by default. A non-empty list makes exec() journal a skipped/missing_credentials terminal record without ever calling run().

status.description: 'attempted' is additive over the design doc's own ok|skipped|retryable|failed|cancelled|replayed — free to add since this family is not yet vendored (T1 is its first ship).

payload.description: BlobRef | JsonValue, never Any (§5.4) — a non-serializable payload must raise before this is constructed, never after.

started_epoch_ms.description: Absolute UTC epoch milliseconds (wall clock, Clock.now_wall_ms) at which the dispatch was issued. Not a monotonic reading: this value is written by one process and read by another, so it must name a moment, not measure an interval.

ended_epoch_ms.description: Absolute UTC epoch milliseconds (wall clock, Clock.now_wall_ms) at which the step reached a terminal outcome. Subtracting started_epoch_ms gives elapsed wall time, which a clock adjustment can distort; the engine measures its own durations off the monotonic clock instead.

journal_seq.description: Ledger T3 (§4.1/§7.4): a per-run monotonic append count, assigned by Journal.append — the record's own replay-stable completion order.
